CheckTitle: Ensure IAM customer-managed policies that allow full '*:*' administrative privileges are not attached
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks whether attached customer-managed policies grant full administrative privileges (Action * on Resource *).
Risk: Custom *:* policies silently create additional administrators outside of any break-glass process.

Recommendation.Text: Rewrite or detach customer-managed policies that grant *:*; scope actions and resources to what is required.
